notes.title: New game has a demo released!
notes.content:
[h3]Hello everyone![/h3][p][/p][p]I’ve released a demo version of my new game — [b]HRROR[/b]. It’s a horror experience set in liminal office spaces, where the most danger is being [b]HIRED[/b]![/p][p]The demo offers a short segment that conveys the atmosphere and overall direction of the project.
I’d really appreciate it if you give it a try and share your impressions in the discussions.[/p][p][/p][h3]You can try out the demo version [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3926800/HRROR/"]Here[/url]![/h3][p][/p][p]Thank you for your time and interest![/p]

notes.title: Update 0.5
notes.content:
Hello everyone! I’m continuing to work on the game and today I’m excited to introduce Update 0.5!

[h1]Main changes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] The Second Level has been reworked and is now available again
[*] Old achievements have been updated, and new ones have been added
[*] The visual style has been adjusted
[*] An option to change image quality has been introduced
[*] Optimization improvements have been made
[/list]

Thank you for staying with me and keeping up with the updates! I really hope you enjoy the changes and have a fresh new experience with the game!

[url=https://x.com/akhsotoen]Follow me on X to stay updated on development and be the first to hear about upcoming announcements![/url]

notes.title: Update 0.4
notes.content:
Dear players, I welcome you!

Thank you for your patience and support during my long absence. I am pleased to announce that work on the project has resumed with renewed energy and inspiration. My goal remains the same — to provide you with the best gaming experience and bring the quality of the game to perfection.

This update is just the first step towards a massive improvement. There are even more innovations and changes ahead of you!

Key changes:
[list]
[*] New visual style: Updated design for a more pleasant experience.
[*] Backrooms Entourage: The redesign of the surroundings has made the atmosphere even more immersive.
[*] Highlighting interactive objects: Important objects are now highlighted when you hover, making interaction easier.
[*] Improved visibility: Objects become more visible in low-light conditions.
[*] Simplified interaction with stairs: The installation of stairs has been visualized.
[*] Realistic behavior of the Boykisser: Now his field of vision depends on the turn of his head.
[*] Floodlights work autonomously: They turn on and off randomly, adding dynamism.
[*] Timer in the pause menu: Now you can track the time to achieve the "Speedrun".
[*] Password display: The entered password is now visible above the combination lock, simplifying the interaction process.
[*] The second level is temporarily closed: It is under revision and will be available again soon.
[*] Bug Fixes: Fixed bugs and improved game stability.
[/list]


I look forward to seeing when you can evaluate these changes and share your impressions. Your feedback is really important and helps to make the game even better!

Stay tuned — there will be even more exciting content and improvements ahead. Thank you for staying and supporting the project!

notes.title: Update v0.3 - Level 2 and Release
notes.content:
[b]Dear players[/b]!

We are pleased to present an update for our game [b]ESCAPE FROM BOYKISSER[/b]!

The main addition is [b]Level 2[/b], which offers a completely new and unique gaming experience! You can learn more about the new level from the description on the Steam store page! Additionally, [b]2 new Achievements[/b] are already waiting for you!

The artificial intelligence of BOYKISSER at Level 1 has been adjusted based on frequent instances of it getting stuck in various parts of the map and uneven movement.

Finally, we are pleased to announce that ESCAPE FROM BOYKISSER is leaving [b]Early Access[/b]! But this does not mean that development is ending here! We continue to work on content that awaits all players in the future!

Thank you for your support and for staying with us!

notes.title: Update v0.2.1
notes.content:
Hello, dear players!

In this small update, we've made efforts to optimize our game based on the feedback we received from you. Now, there's an option in the settings to disable the Lumen system, significantly improving performance.

Thank you for your positive reviews! We appreciate your feedback and your involvement in enhancing our product!

notes.title: Update v0.2!
notes.content:
[b]Dear players![/b]
We are pleased to present an update for our game "Escape From Boykisser" - version 0.2!

[b]Immerse Yourself in the Liminal Spaces of Backrooms[/b]
In this update, the gameplay has been reimagined and redesigned from scratch, providing you with a completely new and unique escape experience from Boykisser in the liminal spaces of Backrooms. You can expect a new series of puzzles to solve, opening the path to escape from the lair of Boykisser.

[b]What's new in version 0.2:[/b]

[list]
[*] Changes in the game level design! Immerse yourself in updated locations with enhanced details and engaging scenarios.

[*] A new series of puzzles! A completely reimagined sequence of puzzles adds a more logical and extended nature to the game, making it even more captivating and challenging.

[*] Improved artificial intelligence of Boykisser: Boykisser has become more unpredictable. You'll need to be attentive and cautious to avoid his embrace.

[*] New achievement! You can earn it by completing the game without Boykisser noticing you even once!
[/list]

Come back to the game to test yourself once again!

notes.title: Fix Update v0.1.2
notes.content:
Dear players!

We are excited to present to you the new update for our game, in which we have made several changes and improvements. Here's what awaits you:

[b]Atmospheric Sound:[/b]
The main feature of the latest update is the revised sound design, created for maximum immersion of the player into the atmosphere of liminal spaces. Now the sounds are more frightening, and every rustle or creak conveys the atmosphere of real horror, making your heart beat faster.

[b]Tail for Boykisser:[/b]
And, no less importantly, the Boykisser model has also undergone some changes—now he has acquired a huge tail! His senses have also sharpened, making being close to him even less safe!

We thank you for your support and hope that these changes will make your gaming experience even more thrilling. If you have any questions or feedback, feel free to contact us.

notes.title: Fix Update v0.1.1
notes.content:
Dear players!

We are excited to introduce the latest update to our game, where we've made several significant changes and improvements. Here's what awaits you:

[b]New Settings Menu:[/b]
Now you have the ability to customize the gameplay to your preferences! We've added a settings menu where you can adjust the volume and mouse sensitivity to make the gaming experience even more comfortable.

[b]Changes in Ladder Movement:[/b]
Please note that the player's movement speed with a folding ladder in hand has been reduced. This change is intended to make the gameplay more realistic and strategic.

[b]Critical Bug Fix:[/b]
We've also successfully addressed a bug where players could receive a notification of successful completion when catching the Boykisser. The game should now operate more stably, allowing you to track your progress more accurately.

Thank you for your support, and we hope these changes will make your gaming experience even more exciting. If you have any questions or feedback, feel free to contact us.
